blocks.text:
After breakfast, depart from the Amazon for Bom Jardim, where the Cerrado meets the rainforest. This includes a short trail to the Enchanted Aquarium and around two hours of snorkelling in clear water; the standalone water activity module is shown below.

After lunch, transfer to Chapada dos Guimarães. Rock formations can be seen along the way. In town, walk through the historic centre and visit the Geodesic Mark of South America viewpoint overlooking the surrounding plains.

Check in at Park Eco Lodge, dinner and overnight.

Meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.
